title: Gate automatic A2A retry behind idempotency
summary: Introduce a disabled-by-default daemon retry gate that can requeue stale leases only when tasks declare duplicate safety and carry an idempotency key, with audit visibility and operator-bounded limits.
expectedFailureModes: Retry silently duplicates non-idempotent external work.
Retry loops create unbounded queue churn on a broken recipient.
Operators cannot distinguish manual repair from daemon-initiated retry in audit or status surfaces.
humanEscalation: Human approval is required before enabling any automatic retry behavior by default.
nextAction: Add a bounded retry gate (disabled by default) plus audit/status visibility and doc the operator controls.
